independent_review_corrections: Removed an unused source_refs projection so the new route retains compatibility with SQLITE_LIMIT_COLUMN=10.

A property binding cannot borrow an explicit subject from another sentence or user question. English sentence punctuation, Chinese sentence punctuation, semicolons and source lines delimit local predicate context.
Only adjacent bare assignment lines may inherit their directly preceding topic header; blank lines, fences, role-prefixed assignments and headers containing existing bindings stop that exception.
Cross-source date exchange additionally requires the same per-property, per-qualified-unit query-topic coverage signature. Directory-completed tokens never enter that signature.
Novelty tracks qualified value facets separately from whole-page question mentions.
Queries statically consisting only of explicit property identifiers, or a single lexical term, skip the necessarily empty supplementary route.

The additional-route path batches metadata, matched-body and current-source IN reads at the preexisting 192-parameter maximum. A three-disjoint-route fixture retains all 288 candidates and produces identical full stable responses under the default and 192-variable SQLite limits, for both limit=5 and limit=50.

New-route batching reads the actual caller variable limit when getlimit is available. A 96-native-plus-20-value fixture retains all 116 candidates and yields identical full stable responses under default and 100-variable SQLite limits, for both limit=5 and limit=50. Ordinary query SQL calls are not changed.
initial_test_errors: The new fixture used strategy=fts; the existing public strategy name is flat.
The new fixture queried a raw task_id without its existing internal task: prefix. The test now resolves its chapter from the source session.
limits: This is literal syntax and lexical context support, not general entity resolution, approval/authority inference, or a state model. Same-unit multiple entities, rejected options, quotations and negation can remain ambiguous.

A current answer whose topic appears only in a user question and whose value appears alone on a separate assistant line normally falls back conservatively. The new route does not inherit arbitrary question or paragraph context.
The extra route recognizes literal name=scalar bindings and exact queried numeric is/are phrases; it is not a general parser for JSON, code, natural-language decisions or every language.
Multiple punctuated query identifiers still require bindings for all such identifiers on one page. This is not general multi-property retrieval across independent sources.

Directory completion can admit partial topical evidence. The per-unit signature prevents treating different topic coverage as one cross-source revision, but partial candidates are not proof of a fully resolved entity or facet.
The value-route cap can still exclude low-BM25 value pages among many other value pages. The implementation does not guarantee recovery of every maintenance-noise omission.
No claim about C5 engineering quality gains or latency is made before the root freezes this candidate and executes the single planned comparison.

mechanism.eligibility: Book strategy, current intent, no historical or event guard, and possible topic terms beyond the explicit property names.
mechanism.ordering: The ordinary lexical prefix is retained; qualifying value pages supplement its bounded reranking pool. Project, chapter, body-term, property, and actual local-topic signatures constrain timestamp exchange. Different signatures can remain together as original evidence.
mechanism.route: The unchanged exact FTS expression and caller scopes constrain the extra route. A precise original-text property/context predicate filters before ordering by the original exact BM25 and LIMIT 96.
mechanism.scan_bound: Only output candidates are capped. The extra route can inspect every scoped FTS match and its full source body. Its cost requires the separately frozen end-to-end replay.
mechanism.source_and_cache: Selected text, original coordinates and source identities remain on the existing read/packing path. RECALL_VERSION 15 separates prior cached rankings. Candidate rows are retained, not silently deleted.
unchanged_paths: Existing same-source later-turn ordering and source excerpt validation

supersedes_summary.reason: The same variable-limit regression also applies to caller limits below 192 when the original native union fits that limit.
